title: Advice for Diabetes Self-Management by ChatGPT Models: Challenges and Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing default AI-generated meal plans for Western-centric dietary preferences and identifying the default assumption of US-standard blood glucose measurement units (mg/dL).

Evaluating the affordability of suggested meal plans by estimating and comparing ingredient costs in different economic contexts (e.g., comparing prices in Australian Dollars versus Pakistani Rupees).
Comparing the comprehensiveness, safety, and informational quality of diabetes management advice generated in English versus Roman Urdu.
